name: agents-md-improver
description: Audit and improve AGENTS.md files in repositories, keeping CLAUDE.md as a one-line @AGENTS.md reference so the same project memory works across tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, …). Use when user asks to check, audit, update, improve, or fix AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md) files. Scans for all such files, evaluates quality against templates, outputs quality report, then makes targeted updates. Also use when the user mentions "AGENTS.md maintenance" or cross-tool "project memory optimization".
